quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: the high-speed interconnect business grew at scale in both domestic and overseas markets; the company deepened strategic cooperation with internet and cloud-computing customers and its related core products passed their technical certification (customers not named), which it says lays the foundation for long-term cooperation. Foreign-trade orders for Category 7A-and-above data cable, connection systems and modules rose rapidly, and the Thailand factory's operating efficiency improved greatly with orders growing at high speed.
